matches.rationale: Finding 15 directly flags that claimed reporting of mean and standard deviation is absent from the tables, matching the ground-truth concern about missing uncertainty quantification in Table 1 and throughout the experiments.

Finding 2 pinpoints the contradiction between Eq.(9) summing over N (visual tokens) and the text specifying alignment at a single layer (n=4 or 8), which is exactly the method logic inconsistency described in GT2.
Finding 5 draws attention to the same abstract sentence and shows it is inconsistent with the main convergence table, thus capturing the underlying overclaim and distortion issue raised in GT3.

Finding 15 notes that standard deviations are not reported despite the text claiming multiple seeds were used, directly addressing the ground-truth critique of missing variability measures across the Experiments section.
No finding identifies the exaggerated superlatives and promotional language in the Introduction; all findings address other categories such as data inconsistency or methodological errors.
No finding mentions the absence of ethical implications, bias discussion, or societal impact statements, so the ethical omission is undetected.

No finding captures the discrepancy between the narrative and Table 16 regarding early-stage underperformance; related table conflicts (finding 6) address table-table inconsistency, not narrative-data misalignment.

No finding discusses missing hyperparameter selection guidance or the lack of λ ablation; the method inconsistency flagged by finding 8 concerns the description of β, not the sparse tuning information.
No finding addresses the potentially fabricated reference REPA-E [21]; all findings focus on experimental or methodological issues within the paper.
No finding identifies the unexpectedly large FID drop from 33.0 to 26.67 in Table 6 without alignment; none of the findings discuss that specific result or its plausibility.
No finding mentions the overgeneralized claim in the Conclusion about fully unleashing discriminative gains; the detected issues are limited to data and methodology inconsistencies.

No finding discusses the potentially misleading characterization of +0.30% parameters and +0.49% latency as entirely negligible; findings 9 and 10 address conflicting values and sign errors in Table 4, not the negligible-overhead claim.
No finding captures the sensational phrasing in the title; the predicted findings do not address rhetorical presentation manipulation in the Abstract.
